summary: Applied a batch of composer UI edits (readonly-while-compacting textarea, usage meter markup, select-field pill styling) and ran svelte-check plus the app test suite, which passed cleanly. Also recorded a memory note after the user stopped a browser-window resize attempt.
decisions: Composer textarea, model select pill, and usage meter should be read-only / inert while a compaction is in progress (the meter cannot be clicked during compaction).

Saved a persistent memory entry instructing future sessions not to resize the user's Chrome window, since the narrow size it ships at (~271px) is the size the user actually runs Gizmo at and is treated as a valid test width.
Refactored the four-file composer edit into a scratchpad Python script after an inline heredoc broke the shell, then ran prettier + svelte-check + vitest from that script.
errors: Initial Bash invocation with a long Python heredoc failed with "unexpected EOF while looking for matching `''`" (exit 2). Recovered by writing the script to the scratchpad and invoking it as a file.
